filesystem.description: The mount point or block device to apply quotas to (e.g. /home, /dev/sda3)

quota_type.description: The type of quota to set: 'user' for users, 'group' for groups

target.description: The username or groupname, or numerical ID (optionally prefixed with ':' for non-passwd ids)

dimension.description: The dimension of the quota: 'block' for disk blocks, 'inode' for file counts

hard_limit.description: The hard limit value with optional modifier (e.g. 1.2G, 2000)

soft_limit.description: The soft limit value with optional modifier (e.g. 800M, 1.8K)

grace_period.description: The grace period for soft limit violations (e.g. 1 week, 5 days, reset)

raise_only.description: If true, use -R flag to only raise quotas, preventing accidental lowering

dry_run.description: If true, use -n flag to perform a dry-run without changing quotas

verbosity.description: Verbosity level: 0 (quiet), 1 (-v), 2 (-v -v). Use caution with level 2.
